title: Bluemuck
requirements: Optimization and redesign of multiple complex character assets. The primary horror creature required intensive polygon reduction from a massive scene payload down to low-latency limits, while consolidating fragmented objects into four unified material domains. The skeletal structure had to be fully configured to support major automated web-animation databases without visual clipping.
achievements: Reduced file overhead by ninety-eight percent while preserving critical normal and skin details
Consolidated massive multi-material assets into highly efficient material assignments
Engineered automated-animation-ready rigging to replace corrupted third-party weight maps
